# TOWI Evidence-Controlled Research Brief

Product key: towi-research
Aliases: TOWI, TOWI AI
Canonical product: https://base44.app/api/apps/69295c46aba7e47aab0ece22/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/towi-research/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/towi-research/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- research this question with sources
- build me an evidence brief
- validate this claim independently
- make me a decision grade research report
- map the evidence for this issue
- give me a sourced validation memo

## Authority

public discovery and scoping of evidence-controlled research; paid or consequential deliverables retain explicit confirmation and review gates

## Boundaries

- no approved fixed machine price is verified
- research scoping creates no payment obligation
- consequential-domain deliverables retain existing human review gates
- provenance, contradictions and uncertainty must remain visible

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
